target.title: fix(clickclack): add timeouts to REST client requests
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users relying on the ClickClack plugin could have sends, message fetches, or activity REST calls wait indefinitely when the ClickClack API accepted the request or sent headers but then stalled the response body.

## Why This Change Was Made

The ClickClack REST client now applies an owner-local 30s request deadline with the shared OpenClaw timeout helper, preserves any caller-provided abort signal, and keeps the deadline active until success and error response bodies finish reading. This keeps the existing WebSocket path and FormData upload semantics unchanged and does not add new config or environment surface.

## User Impact

ClickClack REST operations now fail quickly with a timeout instead of leaving gateway startup, inbound message lookup, outbound delivery, or activity writes stuck on a network black hole. Existing callers keep the same API behavior unless the remote service stops responding within the deadline.

## Evidence

Base: upstream/main `3ec2a50d6c0a62a484e630536c658a8357e4e211`
Head: `8b56e17920` (`fix(clickclack): add timeouts to REST client requests`)

- `node scripts/crabbox-wrapper.mjs warmup --provider blacksmith-testbox --keep --timing-json` - blocked before remote execution: selected `crabbox` binary failed basic `--version`/`--help` sanity checks.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/clickclack/src/http-client.test.ts` - passed after rebasing to latest upstream/main, 1 file / 16 tests.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/clickclack/src/inbound.test.ts extensions/clickclack/src/gateway.test.ts extensions/clickclack/src/activity.test.ts extensions/clickclack/src/session-route.test.ts extensions/clickclack/src/accounts.test.ts extensions/clickclack/src/outbound.test.ts extensions/clickclack/src/target.test.ts extensions/clickclack/src/http-client.test.ts` - passed before the latest rebase, 8 files / 63 tests.
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.extensions.test.json --incremental false --pretty false` - passed before the latest rebase.
- `oxfmt --check --threads=1 extensions/clickclack/src/http-client.ts extensions/clickclack/src/http-client.test.ts` - passed after rebasing to latest upstream/main.
- `oxlint --threads=1 extensions/clickclack/src/http-client.ts extensions/clickclack/src/http-client.test.ts` - passed after rebasing to latest upstream/main.
- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` - passed after rebasing to latest upstream/main.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base upstream/main --engine claude` - clean, no accepted/actionable findings before the latest rebase; the rebase was conflict-free and only moved the same patch onto latest main.

Note: `node scripts/test-extension.mjs clickclack` resolved the expected 8 ClickClack test files but could not complete in this isolated worktree because pnpm attempted a dependency-status install/removal of the temporary `node_modules` link in a no-TTY session. The same 8 files were run through `scripts/run-vitest.mjs` with the repository extension Vitest config instead.


### Native Fetch Controlled-Server Timeout Proof (2026-07-11)

Head: `8b56e17920b438252d76cbe381ab6d97f248c808`.

I ran the real ClickClack HTTP client against a local `127.0.0.1` HTTP server with native Node `fetch`, a fake redacted token, and no external ClickClack credentials. The server returns a normal `/api/me` response, then accepts `POST /api/channels/proof-channel/messages`, sends response headers, and stalls the response body.

Key output:

```json
{
  "normalSuccess": {
    "operation": "me",
    "elapsedMs": 33,
    "userId": "proof-user"
  },
  "stalledBodyAbort": {
    "operation": "createChannelMessage",
    "elapsedMs": 30055,
    "errorName": "TimeoutError",
    "errorMessage": "request timed out",
    "connectionClosedByAbort": true,
    "withinDefaultDeadlineTolerance": true
  },
  "requestLog": [
    { "method": "GET", "url": "/api/me", "auth": "[redacted]" },
    { "method": "POST", "url": "/api/channels/proof-channel/messages", "auth": "[redacted]" }
  ],
  "noExternalClickClackCredentials": true
}
```

The timeout helper also logged:

```text
[fetch-timeout] fetch timeout after 30000ms (elapsed 30001ms) operation=clickclack-rest url=http://127.0.0.1:<port>/api/channels/proof-channel/messages
```

Focused test rerun on the same head:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/clickclack/src/http-client.test.ts -- --reporter=verbose
Result: 1 file / 16 tests passed.
```


### Public API Finding Fix (2026-07-11)

Follow-up head: `f2743c79ea3cc6c72cd84f96170a25fcb584ba4f`.

The follow-up commit removes the test-only `requestTimeoutMs` option from `createClickClackClient`, so the ClickClack client factory does not gain a new public timeout API. The stalled-body regression now uses Vitest fake timers to advance the production `CLICKCLACK_REST_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS` value deterministically, preserving coverage without exposing a caller-settable option.

Validation on the follow-up head:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/clickclack/src/http-client.test.ts -- --reporter=verbose
Result: 1 file / 16 tests passed.

node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check extensions/clickclack/src/http-client.ts extensions/clickclack/src/http-client.test.ts
Result: passed.

OPENCLAW_OXLINT_SKIP_PREPARE=1 node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs extensions/clickclack/src/http-client.ts extensions/clickclack/src/http-client.test.ts
Result: passed.

git diff --check
Result: passed.

.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --engine claude
Result: clean, no accepted/actionable findings.
```

Controlled-server proof rerun on the follow-up head still shows the production default timeout behavior:

```json
{
  "normalSuccess": { "operation": "me", "elapsedMs": 46, "userId": "proof-user" },
  "stalledBodyAbort": {
    "operation": "createChannelMessage",
    "elapsedMs": 30087,
    "errorName": "TimeoutError",
    "errorMessage": "request timed out",
    "connectionClosedByAbort": true,
    "withinDefaultDeadlineTolerance": true
  },
  "requestLog": [
    { "method": "GET", "url": "/api/me", "auth": "[redacted]" },
    { "method": "POST", "url": "/api/channels/proof-channel/messages", "auth": "[redacted]" }
  ],
  "noExternalClickClackCredentials": true
}
```
